checks.summary: Every asserted rail is wired or marked by a matching power symbol on 8/9 designs (dual_buffer, dual_rail_reference, inverting_gain, linear_regulator, noninverting_gain, rc_to_buffer, reference_555_led_flasher_v8, timer_astable); unresolved: {'sallen_key': ['VMINUS']}.

timer_astable (REF wired, VCC power symbols) and the reference 555 v8 (VCC power symbols, REF wired) pass native tools, ERC, electrical equivalence, observed layout, rail presentation and power-symbol clearance.

Final candidates passing every hard check including rail presentation and clearance: dual_buffer, dual_rail_reference, inverting_gain, linear_regulator, noninverting_gain, rc_to_buffer, reference_555_led_flasher_v8, timer_astable. field_owner_association fails on dual_buffer, dual_rail_reference, inverting_gain, noninverting_gain, rc_to_buffer, sallen_key (U1 power-unit reference placement inherited from compiler output).

blockers.summary: Sallen-Key VMINUS stays unresolved after wiring, power-symbol and move-search plans.
Power-symbol renders have agent inspection only.
blockers.next_action: Owner reviews the final candidate images.

notes: Brief v2 rails are geometrically infeasible for the NE555D pin order: a VCC wire joining pins 8 and 4 encloses CONT (pin 5), whose capacitor returns to REF, away from GND pin 1, and crossings are forbidden. Owner direction 2026-10-27 accepted power symbols (brief v3).

Runs 1-3 are retained: run1 aborted on a parallel KiCad instance-lock race; run2 reran dual_buffer; run3 exposed removed decoupling wires and label-form observer conflicts, fixed at 05a9cafb and c1c77832.
Single host run; not locked-host qualification.
